main.title: Starfield
main.summary: Starfield is a 2023 action role-playing game developed by Bethesda Game Studios and published by Bethesda Softworks.

cards.heading: An expedition across planetary systems
cards.text: Starfield is a 2023 action role-playing game developed by Bethesda Game Studios and published by Bethesda Softworks. In the game, the player character joins a group of space explorers who must venture 50 light-years around the Sol System to acquire mysterious artifacts. The game features an open world in the form of a volume within the Milky Way galaxy, containing both fictional and non-fictional planetary systems.

cards.heading: A new setting for the Creation Engine
cards.text: Starfield takes place in a space-themed setting, and is the first new intellectual property developed by Bethesda in 25 years. It was described by its director, Todd Howard, as "Skyrim in space". It was powered by Creation Engine 2, a new iteration of Bethesda's technology developed to support the game's scale and procedural generation system. Active development of the game started following the release of Fallout 4 in 2015.

main.title: F-Zero 99
main.subtitle: Ninety-nine machines share the circuit
main.summary: F-Zero 99 is Nintendo Software Technology's online racing game, released for Nintendo Switch Online members on 14 September 2023.

cards.heading: Ninety-nine machines share the circuit
cards.text: F-Zero 99 is Nintendo Software Technology's online racing game, released for Nintendo Switch Online members on 14 September 2023. It uses the circuits and machines of the original Super Nintendo F-Zero to stage races with as many as ninety-nine competitors. The familiar flat tracks become crowded contests in which reaching the finish depends on surviving collisions as well as driving quickly. The Blue Falcon, Golden Fox, Wild Goose and Fire Stingray return with different strengths for finding a way through that traffic.

cards.heading: Speed spends the same energy as survival
cards.text: The energy meter measures both damage and the fuel available for boosting. Spending it can gain a position but leave the machine vulnerable before the next repair strip. A spin attack pushes other vehicles aside, while knocking out a rival can increase the survivor's energy capacity. As the race progresses, minimum placement requirements remove slower competitors. The player must balance the immediate need to escape elimination with the energy needed to stay intact through the following corners and collisions.

cards.heading: Find the road above the traffic
cards.text: Super Sparks collected from the track fill a separate meter that opens access to the Skyway, a temporary elevated road above the race. It creates an opportunity to overtake the pack without driving through every obstruction below. Grand Prix events extend the contest across several races, making survival and accumulated results part of the same goal. F-Zero 99 finds a new use for the original game's compact circuits by changing the number of people trying to occupy their fastest line.

main.title: Lies of P
main.subtitle: Pinocchio in the city of Krat
main.summary: Lies of P is a 2023 action role-playing game developed by Neowiz and Nough (formerly Round8 Studio) and published by Neowiz.

cards.heading: Pinocchio in the city of Krat
cards.text: Lies of P is a 2023 action role-playing game developed by Neowiz and Nough (formerly Round8 Studio) and published by Neowiz. The story is loosely based on the 1883 Italian novel The Adventures of Pinocchio by Carlo Collodi, to whom it is dedicated. The game is a Soulslike set in the fictional city of Krat, inspired by the Belle Époque. The titular "P" refers to protagonist Pinocchio, whom the player controls from a third-person perspective, and is one of the automaton-like "Puppets" central to life and industry in Krat.

cards.heading: Puppets, Ergo and choices
cards.text: As P, whose freedom of will bypasses Krat's laws of robotics, the player must use melee weapons, a mechanical arm, and "Ergo" energy (serving as both XP and currency) to navigate the enemy-infested city, which is plagued by a "Frenzy" turning other Puppets deadly, using a luxurious hotel as their base of operations. Binary choices by the player affect the outcomes of sub-plots as well as the overall narrative.

cards.heading: Release and critical reception
cards.text: Lies of P arrived on Steam on September 18, 2023, with the announced console launch on September 19; its original platforms were macOS, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Windows, Xbox One, and Xbox Series X/S. It received favourable reviews, with praise directed at its combat, visuals, sound design, and vocal cast, though opinions on its level design and narrative were mixed. By June 2025, the game had sold over 3 million units and was nominated for several year-end accolades, including The Game Awards and the Golden Joystick Awards, appearing on numerous lists of the top video games of 2023.

cards.heading: Overture and later editions
cards.text: A prequel expansion, Overture, was released in June 2025. The Complete Edition, including Overture, was released for Nintendo Switch 2 on August 6, 2026. A sequel is in development.

main.title: Assassin's Creed Mirage
main.summary: Assassin's Creed Mirage is a 2023 action-adventure game developed by Ubisoft Bordeaux and published by Ubisoft.

cards.heading: Basim in ninth-century Baghdad
cards.text: Assassin's Creed Mirage is a 2023 action-adventure game developed by Ubisoft Bordeaux and published by Ubisoft. The game is the thirteenth main installment in the Assassin's Creed series and the successor to Assassin's Creed Valhalla (2020). Set in 9th-century Baghdad during the Islamic Golden Age—in particular during the Anarchy at Samarra—the story follows Basim Ibn Ishaq, a street thief who joins the Hidden Ones to fight for peace and liberty, against the Order of the Ancients, who desire peace through control. The main narrative focuses on Basim's internal struggle between his duties as a Hidden One and his desire to uncover his mysterious past.

cards.heading: Returning to stealth, parkour and assassination
cards.text: Originally envisioned as an expansion for Valhalla, the game was reworked into a standalone title to expand its scope. The design philosophy behind Mirage—the first game to be developed primarily by Ubisoft Bordeaux, previously just a support studio—was to return to the series' roots by focusing on stealth, parkour, and assassinations over the role-playing elements featured heavily in recent installments. As a result, the game is much smaller in scale than its predecessors and combines elements introduced in them with those found in earlier installments of the franchise.

cards.heading: Release, reception and a new direction
cards.text: Mirage was released for PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Windows, Xbox One, and Xbox Series X/S on 5 October 2023, and for iOS on iPhone 15 Pro and iPadOS on iPad models on 6 June 2024. Upon release, the game received generally positive reviews from critics, who praised its world design, focus on stealth and return to form of the franchise, though some criticized the characters and the story's reliance on previous installments in the series. Mirage's successor, Assassin's Creed Shadows, set in Japan during the Sengoku period and returning to the role-playing style of gameplay of previous installments, was released in March 2025.

main.title: Forza Motorsport
main.summary: Forza Motorsport is a 2023 sim racing video game developed by Turn 10 Studios and published by Xbox Game Studios.

cards.heading: A new beginning for Motorsport
cards.text: Forza Motorsport is a 2023 sim racing video game developed by Turn 10 Studios and published by Xbox Game Studios. It is the eighth and most recent Forza Motorsport title, succeeding Forza Motorsport 7, and the thirteenth entry in the Forza series. Forza Motorsport is a reboot for the titular sub-series, dropping the sequential numbering from past entries' titles.

cards.heading: An October launch and a divided reception
cards.text: The game was released for Windows and Xbox Series X/S on October 10, 2023. It received positive reviews from critics upon release and negative reception from players, who criticised the game’s progression system, lack of content, and multiple bugs.

cards.heading: Turn 10 and the later studio merger
cards.text: Forza Motorsport was the last new game released by Turn 10 Studios before its 2026 studio merger. In July 2025, nearly half of the studio were laid off by Microsoft. Whilst Turn 10 was initially restructured into a support team to assist with Forza Horizon and developments on the ForzaTech engine, the studio would later merge with Playground Games in September 2026.

main.title: Lords of the Fallen
main.summary: Lords of the Fallen is an action role-playing video game developed by Hexworks and published by CI Games.

cards.heading: A new journey through Mournstead
cards.text: Lords of the Fallen is an action role-playing video game developed by Hexworks and published by CI Games. A reboot to the 2014 video game of the same name, the game was released for PlayStation 5, Windows, and Xbox Series X/S on 13 October 2023.

cards.heading: Melee, magic and cooperative combat
cards.text: Lords of the Fallen is an action role-playing video game played from a third-person perspective. Like its predecessor, players can use melee weapons and magic to defeat enemies, and the gameplay adapts elements from soulsborne games. The game's campaign can be completed cooperatively with another player. The game features a player-versus-player multiplayer mode.

cards.heading: Between Axiom and Umbral
cards.text: The lantern reveals Umbral, a realm of the dead occupying the same space as the living world of Axiom. A route blocked in one realm may open in the other, making the environment something to compare rather than simply cross. Dying in Axiom sends the player into Umbral for another chance. A second death returns them to a save point and leaves unspent Vigor at the place they fell. Reclaiming it requires another journey through danger. Permanent save points are scarce, but materials from Umbral enemies can create temporary ones, making preparation part of choosing how far to continue.

main.title: Sonic Superstars
main.subtitle: Running Together Requires a Different Rhythm
main.summary: Sonic Team and Arzest bring Sonic's side-scrolling platforming to the Northstar Islands, with local co-op for up to four players.

cards.heading: Running Together Requires a Different Rhythm
cards.text: Sonic Superstars is a side-scrolling platform game developed by Sonic Team and Arzest, with Naoto Ohshima among its creative collaborators. Released on October 17, 2023 for PlayStation, Xbox, Switch and PC, it takes the characters to the Northstar Islands. Three-dimensional graphics present the action on a 2D plane, with Emerald Powers, distinct character abilities and local cooperative play for up to four players.

cards.heading: Speed Needs Readable Terrain
cards.text: Curves and slopes alter the speed of a run, while obstacles and changes in height demand attention to the next landing. Reading the terrain helps the player maintain momentum and choose between routes. The three-dimensional scenery surrounds this side-scrolling action, keeping the playable plane as the point of reference for jumps and movement.

cards.heading: Different Characters Read Different Paths
cards.text: Tails can fly, Knuckles can climb and glide, and Amy uses her jumping and hammer abilities. Choosing a character changes which parts of a level are easiest to reach. A high ledge can become accessible by flight or climbing, encouraging another run through familiar terrain with a different set of abilities.

cards.heading: Sharing the Screen Changes Freedom
cards.text: Local co-op allows up to four players to travel through the adventure together. A shared screen brings different approaches into the same space: one player may want to race ahead while another explores or catches up. Progress depends on finding a pace that keeps the group together, turning an individual run into a coordinated journey.

main.title: Marvel's Spider-Man 2
main.subtitle: Peter and Miles face Kraven and Venom
main.summary: Marvel's Spider-Man 2 is a 2023 action-adventure game developed by Insomniac Games and published by Sony Interactive Entertainment.

cards.heading: Peter and Miles face Kraven and Venom
cards.text: Marvel's Spider-Man 2 is a 2023 action-adventure game developed by Insomniac Games and published by Sony Interactive Entertainment. It is based on the Marvel Comics character Spider-Man, and features a narrative inspired by its long-running comic book mythology which is also derived from various adaptations in other media. It is the third entry in the Marvel's Spider-Man series, acting as a sequel to Marvel's Spider-Man (2018) and a follow-up to Marvel's Spider-Man: Miles Morales (2020). The plot follows Peter Parker and Miles Morales as they come into conflict with Kraven the Hunter, who transforms New York City into a hunting ground for super-powered individuals; and the extraterrestrial Venom symbiote, which bonds itself to Peter and negatively influences him, threatening to destroy his personal relationships.

cards.heading: Two Spider-Men, new powers and traversal
cards.text: The gameplay builds on the foundation established by its predecessors, with an emphasis on the multiple play styles offered by Peter Parker and Miles Morales as Spider-Men. The game expands on their existing traversal and combat abilities, including new web-based gadgets and suits that can be unlocked through progressing in the story. It also introduces the former Spider-Man's symbiote suit, granting Parker unique abilities from his previous playable appearance. As with the prior games, content outside the main story consists of completing side-missions and obtaining collectibles dispersed throughout the game's open world, with the player able to switch between Parker and Morales to complete dedicated objectives for each of them and each with their own unique abilities.

cards.heading: The team and returning performers
cards.text: Discussions regarding a proper sequel to Marvel's Spider-Man began during the game's development, with open story threads for future titles being teased across both it and Miles Morales. The game was announced in September 2021. Creative director Bryan Intihar, game director Ryan Smith, narrative lead Jon Paquette and art director Jacinda Chew from Insomniac Games respectively reprise their duties from prior entries, while Yuri Lowenthal, Nadji Jeter and Laura Bailey return to headline the game's voice cast, which comprises other returning actors and characters from the previous games. Jim Pirri and Tony Todd join the cast as the voices of Kraven and Venom, respectively.

cards.heading: Release, reception and sales
cards.text: Marvel's Spider-Man 2 was released for the PlayStation 5 on October 20, 2023, and was ported to Windows by Nixxes Software on January 30, 2025. The game received universal acclaim, with praise directed towards its narrative, characterization, and gameplay, although its writing received some criticism. It was nominated for numerous end-of-year accolades, and won in six categories at the 27th Annual D.I.C.E. Awards, including Action Game of the Year. The game was also included in many lists of the best games of 2023. The game sold over 2.5 million units in 24 hours and over five million in 11 days, with Sony describing it as the fastest-selling PlayStation Studios game when measured over the first 24 hours. The game has sold over 11 million units as of April 20, 2024.
